jobs.title: Principal Quantum Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Overview
 Microsoft Quantum has assembled a talented and diverse international team to create the world’s first scalable quantum computing system. Our full‑stack approach involves exciting innovation from the physics of quantum devices through scalable readout and control systems based on cryo‑electronics. The Microsoft Quantum program strives to fundamentally change the world of computing to help solve some of humankind’s currently unsolvable problems. We are on the cusp of an accelerated effort in quantum computing. This position offers an opportunity to have a meaningful influence on a revolutionary technology. For more information about the Microsoft Quantum team, please visit https://quantum.microsoft.com/ .

We are seeking a Principal Quantum Systems Architect to define the architecture of scalable classical control and readout systems for large-scale quantum computing. This role focuses on system design at the quantum-classical interface, including compute platforms and communication fabrics. This is a strategic technical leadership role, shaping long-term architecture while guiding validation and integration across the stack.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Define the system architecture for scalable quantum control and readout

• Drive architectural direction for heterogeneous compute platforms supporting control, measurement, and feedback workloads

• Establish system partitioning and co-design strategies across hardware, firmware, microarchitecture, software, and quantum systems

• Lead the collaboration with third-party quantum hardware partners in Europe

• Lead system-level trade-offs and guide platform evolution toward scalable, production-ready quantum systems

• Other:
• Embody our Culture and Values

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• Doctorate in Physics, Engineering, or related field AND experience in industry or in a research and development environment

• Master's Degree in Physics, Engineering, or related field AND experience in industry or in a research and development environment

• OR Bachelor's Degree in Physics, Engineering, or related field AND experience in industry or in a research and development environment

• OR equivalent experience.

• Experience driving architectural trade-offs across performance, scalability, power, and reliability

Other Requirements:

• Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
• Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

• Citizenship & Citizenship Verification: This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) or Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

• Familiarity with basic AI tools such as Office CoPilot, GitHub CoPilot, or Chat GPT.

• Ability to work in an “AI-first” environment using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery through both hardware and software development.
 Preferred Qualifications:

• Proven experience designing complex compute or signal-processing architectures (e.g., SoCs, distributed systems, accelerators, networking fabrics)

• Proficient understanding of system architecture fundamentals (compute, memory, interconnects, data movement, HW/SW partitioning)

• Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional hardware/software co-design initiatives

• Familiarity with quantum control, readout, or error correction concepts

• Experience with FPGA, ASIC, or custom accelerator technologies

• Exposure to cryogenic or constrained computing environments

• Experience defining scalable architectures for emerging compute platforms

Panoramica
Microsoft Quantum ha assemblato un team internazionale di talento e diversificato per creare il primo sistema di calcolo quantistico scalabile al mondo. Il nostro approccio full-stack coinvolge l'innovazione entusiasmante dalla fisica dei dispositivi quantici attraverso sistemi di lettura e controllo scalabili basati sulla crio-elettronica. Il programma Microsoft Quantum si sforza di cambiare fondamentalmente il mondo del calcolo per aiutare a risolvere alcuni dei problemi attualmente irrisolvibili dell'umanità. Siamo sull'esempio di uno sforzo accelerato nel calcolo quantico. Questa posizione offre l'opportunità di avere un'influenza significativa su una tecnologia rivoluzionaria. Per ulteriori informazioni sul team Microsoft Quantum, visitare https://quantum.microsoft.com/ .

Stiamo cercando un Principal Quantum Systems Architect per definire l'architettura dei sistemi scalabili di controllo classico e di lettura per il calcolo quantistico su larga scala. Questo ruolo si concentra sulla progettazione del sistema all'interfaccia quantistica-classica, tra cui piattaforme di calcolo e tessuti di comunicazione. Questo è un ruolo di leadership tecnica strategica, modellando l'architettura a lungo termine, guidando la validazione e l'integrazione attraverso lo stack.

La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti, ci uniamo con una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

responsabilità

• Definire l'architettura di sistema per il controllo quantistico scalabile e la lettura

• Guidare la direzione architettonica per piattaforme di calcolo eterogenee che supportano il controllo, la misurazione e i carichi di lavoro di feedback

• Stabilire le strategie di partizionamento e co-progettazione del sistema attraverso hardware, firmware, microarchitettura, software e sistemi quantistici

• Condurre la collaborazione con partner hardware quantistici di terze parti in Europa

• O Laurea in Fisica, Ingegneria, o relativo campo E esperienza nell'industria o in un ambiente di ricerca e sviluppo

Preferiti:

• Esperienza comprovata nella progettazione di architetture complesse di calcolo o di elaborazione del segnale (ad esempio, SoC, sistemi distribuiti, acceleratori, tessuti di rete)

• Compute, memoria, interconnessioni, movimento dati, partizionamento HW/SW)

• Leadership dimostrata in iniziative di co-design hardware/software cross-funzionali

• Familiarità con i concetti di controllo quantistico, lettura o correzione di errore

• Esperienza con tecnologie FPGA, ASIC o acceleratore personalizzato

Übersicht
Microsoft Quantum hat ein talentiertes und vielfältiges internationales Team zusammengestellt, um das weltweit erste skalierbare Quantencomputersystem zu entwickeln. Unser Full-Stack-Ansatz beinhaltet spannende Innovationen aus der Physik von Quantenbauelementen durch skalierbare Auslese- und Steuerungssysteme auf Basis von Kryoelektronik. Das Microsoft Quantum-Programm ist bestrebt, die Computerwelt grundlegend zu verändern, um einige der derzeit unlösbaren Probleme der Menschheit zu lösen. Wir stehen an der Schwelle zu einer beschleunigten Anstrengung im Quantencomputing. Diese Position bietet die Möglichkeit, einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf eine revolutionäre Technologie zu haben. Weitere Informationen zum Microsoft Quantum Team finden Sie unter https://quantum.microsoft.com/ .

Wir suchen einen Principal Quantum Systems Architect, der die Architektur skalierbarer klassischer Steuerungs- und Auslesesysteme für das Quantencomputing im großen Maßstab definiert. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf das Systemdesign an der quantenklassischen Schnittstelle, einschließlich Rechenplattformen und Kommunikationsstrukturen. Dies ist eine strategische technische Führungsrolle, die die langfristige Architektur gestaltet und gleichzeitig die Validierung und Integration über den gesamten Stack hinweg leitet.

Microsofts Mission ist es, jede Person und jedes Unternehmen auf dem Planeten zu befähigen, mehr zu erreichen. Als Mitarbeiter kommen wir mit einer Wachstumsmentalität zusammen, innovieren, um andere zu stärken, und arbeiten zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Jeden Tag bauen wir auf unseren Werten Respekt, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht auf, um eine Kultur der Inklusion zu schaffen, in der jeder bei der Arbeit und darüber hinaus gedeihen kann.

Zuständigkeiten

• Definieren Sie die Systemarchitektur für skalierbare Quantensteuerung und Auslesen

• Architekturrichtung für heterogene Rechenplattformen, die Steuerungs-, Mess- und Feedback-Workloads unterstützen

• Etablieren Sie Systempartitionierungs- und Co-Design-Strategien für Hardware, Firmware, Mikroarchitektur, Software und Quantensysteme

Le programme Microsoft Quantum s'efforce de changer fondamentalement le monde de l'informatique pour aider à résoudre certains problèmes de l'humanité actuellement insolvables. Nous sommes sur le point d'un effort accéléré dans le calcul quantique. Cette position offre l'occasion d'avoir une influence significative sur une technologie révolutionnaire. Pour de plus amples renseignements sur l'équipe de Microsoft Quantum, veuillez consulter https://quantum.microsoft.com/ .

• Définir l'architecture du système pour le contrôle quantique évolutive et la lecture

Aperçu général
Visual Studio Code est l'endroit où des millions de développeurs transforment des idées en logiciels de travail. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel senior à Zurich pour aider à construire sa prochaine génération d'expériences d'édition, de développement et de GitHub Copilot.
Vous aiderez à rendre les flux de travail complexes des développeurs se sentent simples, du codage quotidien et de débogage à la délégation de travail à l'IA. Il s'agit d'une ingénierie de produit pratique dans une large base de code TypeScript et Rust : vous façonnerez une fonction ou une direction technique, l'implémenterez et continuerez à l'améliorer après la sortie. Nous apprécions les ingénieurs qui se soucient de ce que ressent le logiciel, qui prennent des décisions judicieuses au milieu de l'ambiguïté et qui apprennent de ce qu'ils expédient.

À propos de l'équipe
Nous travaillons en plein air, avec la rétroaction directe des développeurs et des auteurs d'extension. Vous collaborerez avec les ingénieurs, les concepteurs, les chercheurs et les équipes de produits de notre équipe, GitHub et Microsoft. Nous combinons la rétroaction communautaire, la recherche, les expériences et le jugement d'ingénierie pour décider quoi construire. Performance, accessibilité, extensibilité, sécurité et contrôle des développeurs font partie du produit, et non des touches de finition.

Exemples de travaux
Le rôle s'étend au code VS de base et au copilote; les projets illustratifs comprennent :

• Améliorer la navigation et l'édition dans les grands dépôts sans ralentir le démarrage ou la saisie.

• Construisez un workflow Copilot qui aide les développeurs à déléguer une tâche de codage, à inspecter les changements et à les valider à l'aide des outils de révision, de test et de débogage de VS Code.

• Étendre les API VS Code afin que les nouvelles capacités fonctionnent de manière fiable avec les extensions existantes et les environnements de développement à distance.

• Affiner notre processus d'ingénierie existant avec des outils personnalisés adaptés pour le débit et la qualité.

Responsabilités

• Identifier les possibilités de produits et d'ingénierie, aider à définir ce qu'il faut construire par la rétroaction des utilisateurs, l'expérimentation et les connaissances techniques.

• Formez la direction technique dans votre région, en conciliant les besoins de produits à court terme avec la maintenance à long terme.

• Diriger la conception pratique, la mise en oeuvre, l'essai et la livraison des fonctions VS Code, coordonner les contributeurs et les dépendances des équipes partenaires au besoin.

• Résultats après publication : comprendre l'adoption, étudier les questions de qualité et utiliser la télémétrie, les évaluations et la rétroaction des utilisateurs pour orienter les améliorations.

• Améliorer la réactivité et la fiabilité grâce au profilage, au débogage et aux tests automatisés; renforcer les outils qui permettent à l'équipe d'expérimenter et d'expédier avec confiance.

• Travailler en public : discuter publiquement des conceptions, enquêter sur les problèmes signalés par la communauté et collaborer directement avec les développeurs et les auteurs de vulgarisation.

• Ingénieurs mentors et améliorer les décisions techniques grâce à des examens constructifs de la conception et du code.

• Promuovere l'adozione della piattaforma a lungo termine, la crescita dei consumi e il sostegno dei clienti.

Overview
 We are seeking a Data Research Engineer to join our AI team , where we are building the next generation of foundation models across different modalities: text, image, video, audio. If you are passionate about exploring, designing, and building high-quality datasets to drive frontier AI models, this role is for you.

At Microsoft AI, data is at the heart of innovation—and in this role, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues to curate, analyse, and evaluate diverse data sources critical to model development. You’ll lead efforts in developing novel data collection strategies, improving dataset quality, understanding data-driven model behaviours, and aligning datasets with ethical and societal values.

This is a cross-disciplinary, high-impact role ideal for engineers who want to push the boundaries of what AI can learn from data.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Create high-quality datasets for training and evaluation; run experiments on new datasets (data ablations) to assess their impact and determine the most effective data

• Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, pre-processing, filtering, and annotation

• Analyse real-world multimodal datasets to assess quality, diversity, relevance, and identify areas for improvement

• Build tools and workflows for dataset auditing, visualization, and versioning

• Collaborate with Safety, Ethics, and Governance teams to ensure datasets meet standards for quality, privacy, and responsible AI practices

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree in AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Proficiency in Python.

• Experience with distributed data-processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray and workflow-orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience with processing datasets at many petabyte scale and with trillion rows.

• Experience building datasets for training foundation models, including language or multimodal models.

• Strong experience in data analysis, data engineering, or both.

• Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and effectively to research, engineering, and product teams.

• Experience evaluating dataset quality and measuring the impact of data through controlled model-training experiments.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

• Experience working with large-scale, real-world datasets that are unstructured or semi-structured

• Experience with multimodal data, such as image, video, or audio data.

Overview
 Visual Studio Code is where millions of developers turn ideas into working software. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in Zurich to tackle hard product and platform challenges as VS Code and GitHub Copilot continue to reshape how developers build software.
 You will help to evolve VS Code as a market leading developer environment, seamlessly connecting its editor, agentic coding abilities, platform and extension ecosystem. You will identify where investment matters, prove difficult ideas in code, and establish approaches that multiple teams can build on. This is hands-on technical leadership: the opportunity to change both what developers can accomplish and what our engineering teams can deliver.

About the team
 We work in the open, with direct feedback from developers and extension authors. You will partner with engineers, designers, researchers, and product leaders across our team, GitHub, and Microsoft. We combine community feedback, research, experiments, and engineering judgment to decide what to build. Performance, accessibility, extensibility, security, and developer control are part of the product, not finishing touches.

Examples of work
 The role spans core VS Code and Copilot; illustrative projects include:

• Address architectural bottlenecks in large workspaces, proving an approach in code that multiple feature teams can adopt.

• Define extension or workspace APIs that unlock new capabilities while preserving compatibility with existing extensions and remote development environments.

• Prototype how developers delegate, review, and validate work with Copilot, then establish the product and platform boundaries needed to ship it.

• Reshape and support our engineering process with custom solutions fine-tuned for throughput and quality.

Responsibilities

• Identify significant product opportunities and systemic engineering problems; set technical direction that balances near-term delivery with long-term product and platform health.

• Prove approaches through prototypes, critical implementation, testing, and difficult debugging, using hands-on work to guide architectural decisions.

• Lead cross-team delivery across Microsoft and GitHub, resolving architectural disagreements, clarifying ownership and API boundaries, and enabling teams to deliver independently.

• Own outcomes beyond release, using adoption, quality signals, evaluations, experiments, and user feedback to guide investment and adjust course.

• Improve engineering effectiveness across teams through testing strategies, performance work, shared design patterns, and tools for rapid, reliable experimentation.

• Lead technical discussions in the open, investigate community-reported issues, and work directly with developers and extension authors to shape designs.

• Mentor experienced engineers and technical leaders, helping them develop judgment and take ownership without making yourself a bottleneck.

Qualifications
 Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

• Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams, including setting direction, building alignment, and delivering substantial initiatives without relying on reporting-line authority.

• Solid hands-on coding and design skills, with the ability to become productive in large TypeScript and Rust codebases.

• Experience designing shared platforms, APIs, or large application architectures, with sound judgment about extensibility, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.

• Solid product judgment, including identifying opportunities, setting priorities amid ambiguity, and turning technical decisions into practical designs and measurable improvements for users.

• A track record of mentoring experienced engineers and improving the effectiveness of teams beyond your immediate area.

• Clear communication skills, including explaining complex technical decisions and navigating tradeoffs with engineering and product partners.

 We welcome a range of product backgrounds; these are helpful experiences, not a checklist. Previous work on developer tools, open-source projects, or AI products is not required.

• Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

• Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript and Rust.

• Experience evolving interactive products with attention to usability and accessibility.

• Experience guiding cross-platform architecture, performance improvements, or major migrations in a large application.

• Experience establishing experimentation and feedback practices that connect engineering decisions to user outcomes.

• Practical familiarity with AI coding tools and sound judgment about where they help, where they fall short, and how they change development workflows.

• Experience providing technical leadership on AI-powered products, open-source projects, or extensible applications.

Nous travaillons en plein air, avec la rétroaction directe des développeurs et des auteurs d'extension. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des ingénieurs, des concepteurs, des chercheurs et des chefs de file dans notre équipe, GitHub et Microsoft. Overview
 AI & Technology Transformation Executive, Financial Services
 Drive AI-led business transformation across Switzerland’s leading financial institutions by combining the commercial ownership of an Account Executive, the technical credibility of a Technology Advisor and the strategic perspective of a Transformation Consultant.
 The successful candidate will develop and own strategic customer relationships, account plans and growth opportunities while helping customers evolve into frontier organisations through Microsoft’s Cloud, Data and AI platforms.
 We are looking for a combination of executive strategist, technology advisor, AI transformation leader and commercial deal maker.
 The individual should be equally comfortable discussing Agentic Process Reingeneering with COOs, Data & AI strategy with CIOs and CDOs, and AI-led business transformation with CEOs, CFOs and executive committees.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
 Customer & Executive Leadership

• Proactively cultivate trusted relationships across customer organisations, from architects and technology leaders through to C-level executives.

• Build deep understanding of each customer’s business strategy, technology landscape, priorities, industry dynamics and transformation agenda.

• Become a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Heads of AI and business executives.

• Lead strategic conversations that connect technology decisions with measurable business outcomes.

• Establish executive relationships that create long-term alignment and position Microsoft as a strategic transformation partner.
 Account & Commercial Leadership

• Own the strategic account plan and orchestrate its execution across Microsoft.

• Think strategically about where Microsoft should invest resources, expertise and executive engagement to maximise customer and Microsoft outcomes.

• Identify, create and shape new growth opportunities across Azure, Data, AI, Copilot and related Microsoft platforms.

• Develop compelling value propositions, business cases and transformation roadmaps.

• Drive upsell and cross-sell opportunities by connecting customer priorities with Microsoft capabilities.

• Lead complex opportunities from early strategic discussions through technical shaping, commercial strategy and execution.

• Maintain a clear view of the external market landscape and develop differentiated strategies to win.
 One Microsoft Orchestration

• Lead extended virtual teams spanning Account Technology Strategists, Specialists, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, Industry, Engineering and Partners.

• Bring together the right Microsoft and partner capabilities around the customer’s most important transformation priorities.

• Establish clear priorities and ensure teams are focused on the opportunities with the greatest strategic and commercial impact.

• Translate technical capabilities into compelling business outcomes for executives and business decision makers.

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, AND solid experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, business transformation, enterprise technology strategy, Financial Services, or related roles;
• OR equivalent experience.

• Proven experience operating at the intersection of technology, consulting, and business transformation AND ability to engage confidently in architecture, business strategy, and commercial discussions with business and technical stakeholders.

• Experience driving enterprise-wide digital, cloud, data, or AI transformation initiatives.

• Solid understanding of complex enterprise technology environments and business outcomes enabled through technology.
 Preferred Qualifications

• Experience within highly regulated industries, particularly:
• Banking

• Insurance

• Wealth Management

• Financial Services

• Technology Consulting

• Management Consulting

• Deep understanding of security, compliance, data governance, sovereignty, risk management, and enterprise architecture principles.

• Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value and executive-level strategic discussions.

• Experience working with top executives and influencing technology and business transformation agendas.

jobs.description:
Overview
 Are you looking to make a broad impact across a dynamic organization, work closely with executives, and grow toward a future Chief of Staff role? If so, this opportunity could be the perfect fit.

As Account Team Unit (ATU) Business Manager, you will partner with the Switzerland three ATU leads to optimize sales team processes and capabilities across Enterprise Commercial, Financial Services, and Public Sector. You will play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence, strategic alignment, and customer engagement readiness.
 We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented team player with excellen communication skills, a passion for execution and process improvement, and a desire to help the Switzerland organization thrive.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Business Operations, Planning & Change Management
 Partners with the Swiss Office Team and ATU stakeholders to drive planning processes, ensuring alignment with corporate rhythms and integration across the broader organization.
 Partners with ATU leaders on strategic business planning, providing insights, recommendations, and decision-support to drive business outcomes and organizational priorities.
 Synthesizes business performance data, market trends, and organizational insights into executive-level recommendations and action plans.
 Manages the Rhythm of Business (ROB) motions, including fiscal year planning, business reviews, customer/partner engagement, events (internal/external), and strategic initiatives in close collaboration with Sales Excellence, Finance, and other key stakeholders.
 Collaborates with EMEA and global teams to land programs and initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment and execution excellence.
 Identifies and advocates for performance improvement actions, working closely with SE&O on resource planning, blueprint optimization, and headcount management.
 Supports the landing of the organization’s transformational goals across HR, Customer Experience, Finance, and Business Planning pillars.
 Promotes ATU identity and culture through the orchestration of town halls, leadership workshops, and team offsites, fostering alignment, engagement, and a shared sense of purpose across the Switzerland ATU.
 Builds partnerships across Sales Excellence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, Communications, and EMEA business management teams to drive execution of key priorities and organizational objectives
 Drives continuous improvement by capturing and acting on team feedback through platforms such as Employee Signals, Employee Listening, and other feedback loops, ensuring that insights are translated into meaningful actions that enhance team effectiveness and engagement.

• Executive Leader and Team Communications
 Executes ATU internal communications strategy and programs. Reviews, supports, and helps to refine work of team members with relevant content (e.g., customer/partner decks, event decks, results summaries, team SharePoint).

• Customer & Executive Engagement Readiness
 Partners with account teams and executives to drive high-impact customer engagements through strategic briefing preparation, messaging alignment, executive readiness, and post-engagement follow-through.
 Supports the development of customer engagement frameworks that drive consistency, impact, and measurable outcomes.

• Maximizing / Extending the ATU Leadership Team
 Acts as a trusted advisor to the Switzerland ATU leadership team, ensuring alignment on priorities, decision making, executive follow-through, and organizational effectiveness.
 Drives leadership team cadence, agenda management, action tracking, and cross-functional accountability.

• Special Projects, Programs & Initiatives
 Leads or contributes to cross-team strategic projects that address evolving business needs.
 Executes hands-on work across multiple disciplines, including strategic efforts that require coordination, analysis, and stakeholder management.
 Drives initiatives that enhance organizational effectiveness, employee experience, and customer satisfaction.

• AI Transformation
 Identifies opportunities to improve team productivity and effectiveness through automation, AI-enabled solutions, and process innovation.

Qualifications
 Required/Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Management, Computer Science) AND experience in business management experience in field/sales environments and working on rhythm-of-business activities including business operations, business management, finance, or other similar environments

• OR equivalent experience

• Experience in orchestrating executive sponsor engagement strategies, including briefing preparation, stakeholder alignment, and follow-up accountability to elevate customer impact.

• Track record of leading cross-functional programs and special projects that drive business transformation, customer satisfaction, and internal process optimization.
 Preferred Qualifications:

• German (written and verbal) is strongly preferred, to effectively engage with regional stakeholders and support communication across German-speaking markets. French and Italian would be an additional asset.

In qualità di Account Team Unit (ATU) Business Manager, sarete partner con la Svizzera tre ATU porta ad ottimizzare i processi e le capacità del team di vendita attraverso Enterprise Commercial, Financial Services e Public Sector. Si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel guidare l'eccellenza operativa, l'allineamento strategico e la disponibilità di impegno del cliente.
Siamo alla ricerca di un team player ad alta energia, orientato al dettaglio con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, una passione per l'esecuzione e il miglioramento dei processi, e il desiderio di aiutare l'organizzazione svizzera a prosperare.
La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti ci uniamo con una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

responsabilità

• Operazioni aziendali, pianificazione e gestione dei cambiamenti
Partner del team di uffici e degli stakeholder ATU per guidare i processi di pianificazione, garantendo l'allineamento con i ritmi aziendali e l'integrazione in tutta l'organizzazione più ampia.
Partner con i leader ATU sulla pianificazione strategica delle imprese, fornendo informazioni, raccomandazioni e supporto decisionale per guidare i risultati aziendali e le priorità organizzative.
sintetizza i dati delle prestazioni aziendali, le tendenze del mercato e le intuizioni organizzative su raccomandazioni e piani di azione a livello esecutivo.
Gestisce i movimenti Rhythm of Business (ROB), tra cui la pianificazione dell'anno fiscale, le recensioni aziendali, il coinvolgimento del cliente/partner, gli eventi (internal/esterno), e le iniziative strategiche in stretta collaborazione con Sales Excellence, Finance e altri stakeholder chiave.
Collabora con EMEA e team globali per programmi e iniziative di terra, garantendo l'allineamento interfunzionale e l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione.
Identificare e sostenere le azioni di miglioramento delle prestazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con SE&O sulla pianificazione delle risorse, l'ottimizzazione dei progetti e la gestione dei conti.
Supporta lo sbarco degli obiettivi di trasformazione dell'organizzazione attraverso i pilastri HR, Customer Experience, Finance e Business Planning.
Promuove l'identità e la cultura dell'ATU attraverso l'orchestrazione di sale comunali, laboratori di leadership e dipartimenti di team, promuovendo l'allineamento, l'impegno e un senso comune di scopo in tutta la Svizzera ATU.
Costruire partnership tra Eccellenza Vendite, Finanza, HR, Marketing, Successo dei Clienti, Comunicazioni e team di gestione aziendale EMEA per guidare l'esecuzione di priorità chiave e obiettivi organizzativi
Guida il miglioramento continuo catturando e agendo sul feedback del team attraverso piattaforme come Segnali dei dipendenti, Ascoltare i dipendenti e altri loop di feedback, assicurando che gli insight siano tradotti in azioni significative che migliorano l'efficacia e l'impegno del team.

• Leader esecutivo e comunicazioni di gruppo
Esegui la strategia di comunicazione interna ATU e i programmi. Recensioni, supporti e aiuta a perfezionare il lavoro dei membri del team con contenuti rilevanti (ad esempio, piattaforme clienti/partner, mazzi eventi, sintesi dei risultati, team SharePoint).

• Customer & Executive Engagement
Partner con team di account e dirigenti per guidare gli impegni dei clienti ad alto impatto attraverso la preparazione strategica di briefing, l'allineamento di messaggistica, la prontezza esecutiva e il follow-through post-engagement.
Supporta lo sviluppo di strutture di coinvolgimento del cliente che guidano consistenza, impatto e risultati misurabili.

• Massimizzare / Estendere il team di leadership ATU
Agisce come consulente di fiducia per il team di leadership della Svizzera ATU, assicurando l'allineamento sulle priorità, il processo decisionale, il follow-through esecutivo e l'efficacia organizzativa.
Guida la cadenza del team di leadership, la gestione dell'ordine del giorno, il monitoraggio delle azioni e la responsabilità trasversale.

• Progetti speciali, programmi e iniziative
Conduce o contribuisce a cross-team progetti strategici che rispondono alle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione.
Esegui il lavoro pratico su più discipline, tra cui gli sforzi strategici che richiedono coordinamento, analisi e gestione degli stakeholder.
Guida iniziative che migliorano l'efficacia organizzativa, l'esperienza dei dipendenti e la soddisfazione del cliente.

• Trasformazione dell'AI
Identificare le opportunità per migliorare la produttività e l'efficacia del team attraverso l'automazione, soluzioni AI-enabled e l'innovazione di processo.

Qualifiche
Required/Minimum Qualificazioni

• Bachelor's Degree in campo rilevante (ad esempio, Business Administration, Management, Computer Science) E esperienza nella gestione aziendale negli ambienti di campo/vendita e lavorando su attività ritmiche di business tra cui operazioni aziendali, gestione aziendale, finanza o altri ambienti simili

• O esperienza equivalente

• Esperienza nell'organizzazione di strategie di coinvolgimento degli sponsor esecutivi, tra cui preparazione di briefing, allineamento delle parti interessate e responsabilità di follow-up per elevare l'impatto del cliente.

• Traccia il record dei principali programmi interfunzionali e progetti speciali che guidano la trasformazione aziendale, la soddisfazione del cliente e l'ottimizzazione dei processi interni.
Preferiti:

• Il tedesco (scritto e verbale) è fortemente preferito, per impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder regionali e sostenere la comunicazione attraverso i mercati di lingua tedesca. Francese e italiano sarebbe un'ulteriore risorsa.

Möchten Sie eine breite Wirkung in einer dynamischen Organisation erzielen, eng mit Führungskräften zusammenarbeiten und auf eine zukünftige Rolle des Stabschefs zusteuern? Wenn ja, könnte diese Gelegenheit die perfekte Lösung sein.

Als Business Manager der Account Team Unit (ATU) arbeiten Sie mit drei ATU-Leitern der Schweiz zusammen, um die Prozesse und Fähigkeiten des Vertriebsteams in den Bereichen Enterprise Commercial, Financial Services und Public Sector zu optimieren. Wir suchen einen energiegeladenen, detailorientierten Teamplayer mit hervorragenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, einer Leidenschaft für die Ausführung und Prozessverbesserung und dem Wunsch, der Schweizer Organisation zum Erfolg zu verhelfen.

Als Mitarbeiter kommen wir mit einer Wachstumsmentalität zusammen, innovieren, um andere zu stärken, und arbeiten zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Jeden Tag bauen wir auf unseren Werten Respekt, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht auf, um eine Kultur der Inklusion zu schaffen, in der jeder bei der Arbeit und darüber hinaus gedeihen kann.

Zuständigkeiten

• Business Operations, Planung & Change Management
Zusammenarbeit mit dem Swiss Office Team und den ATU-Stakeholdern, um die Planungsprozesse voranzutreiben und die Abstimmung mit den Unternehmensrhythmen und die Integration in der gesamten Organisation sicherzustellen.
Partner mit ATU-Führungskräften bei der strategischen Geschäftsplanung und bietet Einblicke, Empfehlungen und Entscheidungshilfe, um Geschäftsergebnisse und organisatorische Prioritäten zu fördern.
Synthetisiert Geschäftsleistungsdaten, Markttrends und organisatorische Einblicke in Empfehlungen und Aktionspläne auf Führungsebene.
Verwaltet die Rhythm of Business (ROB) -Bewegungen, einschließlich der Geschäftsjahresplanung, Geschäftsbewertungen, Kunden- / Partnerbindung, Veranstaltungen (intern / extern) und strategischen Initiativen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales Excellence, Finance und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern.
Arbeitet mit EMEA und globalen Teams zusammen, um Programme und Initiativen zu landen und so eine funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung und Ausführungsqualität zu gewährleisten.
Identifiziert und befürwortet Performance-Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und arbeitet eng mit SE & O in den Bereichen Ressourcenplanung, Blueprint-Optimierung und Headcount-Management zusammen.
Unterstützt die Landung der Transformationsziele des Unternehmens in den Säulen HR, Customer Experience, Finance und Business Planning.

Aufbau von Partnerschaften zwischen Sales Excellence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, Communications und EMEA Business Management Teams, um die Umsetzung wichtiger Prioritäten und organisatorischer Ziele voranzutreiben
Steigende Verbesserung durch Erfassung und Handeln auf Team-Feedback durch Plattformen wie Mitarbeiter-Signale, Mitarbeiter-Hören und andere Feedback-Schleifen, um sicherzustellen, dass Erkenntnisse in sinnvolle Aktionen umgesetzt werden, die die Effektivität und das Engagement des Teams verbessern.

Führt interne ATU-Kommunikationsstrategien und -programme aus. Überprüfen, unterstützen und verfeinern Sie die Arbeit von Teammitgliedern mit relevanten Inhalten (z. B. Kunden- / Partnerdecks, Ereignisdecks, Ergebniszusammenfassungen, Team SharePoint).

Unterstützt die Entwicklung von Customer Engagement Frameworks, die Konsistenz, Auswirkungen und messbare Ergebnisse fördern.

Funktioniert als vertrauenswürdiger Berater des Schweizer ATU-Führungsteams und gewährleistet die Ausrichtung auf Prioritäten, Entscheidungsfindung, Follow-Through und organisatorische Effektivität.
Betreibt die Kadenz des Führungsteams, das Agenda-Management, das Action-Tracking und die funktionsübergreifende Rechenschaftspflicht.

Leitet oder trägt zu teamübergreifenden strategischen Projekten bei, die auf sich ändernde Geschäftsanforderungen eingehen.
Führt praktische Arbeit in mehreren Disziplinen durch, einschließlich strategischer Bemühungen, die Koordination, Analyse und Stakeholder-Management erfordern.
Fördert Initiativen, die die organisatorische Effektivität, die Mitarbeitererfahrung und die Kundenzufriedenheit verbessern.

Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Teamproduktivität und -effektivität durch Automatisierung, KI-fähige Lösungen und Prozessinnovation.

Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Management, Informatik) UND Erfahrung in Business-Management-Erfahrung in Feld / Sales-Umgebungen und Arbeiten an Rhythmus-of-Business-Aktivitäten einschließlich Geschäftsbetrieb, Business Management, Finanzen oder anderen ähnlichen Umgebungen

Aperçu général
Vous cherchez à avoir un large impact dans une organisation dynamique, à travailler en étroite collaboration avec les cadres et à devenir un futur chef de cabinet? Si oui, cette opportunité pourrait être parfaite.

En tant que responsable d'entreprise de l'unité de compte (ATU), vous vous associerez à la Suisse trois ATU mènent à optimiser les processus et les capacités de l'équipe de vente dans les secteurs commercial, financier et public. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'excellence opérationnelle, l'alignement stratégique et l'engagement des clients.
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un team player de haute énergie, axé sur les détails, doté d'excellentes compétences en communication, d'une passion pour l'exécution et l'amélioration des processus, et d'un désir d'aider l'organisation suisse à prospérer.
La mission de Microsoft est d'habiliter chaque personne et chaque organisation de la planète à réaliser davantage. En tant qu'employés, nous nous associons à une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour responsabiliser les autres et collaborons pour réaliser nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d'intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d'inclusion où chacun peut prospérer au travail et au-delà.

Responsabilités

• Opérations, planification et gestion du changement
Partenaires avec l'équipe du Bureau suisse et les parties prenantes de l'ATU pour diriger les processus de planification, assurer l'alignement avec les rythmes d'entreprise et l'intégration dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
Partenaires avec les dirigeants de l'ATU dans la planification stratégique des activités, fournissant des idées, des recommandations et un soutien à la décision pour stimuler les résultats opérationnels et les priorités organisationnelles.
Synthèse des données sur le rendement des entreprises, des tendances du marché et des renseignements organisationnels sur les recommandations et les plans d'action des cadres supérieurs.
Gère les motions du Rhythme des affaires (ROB), y compris la planification de l'exercice financier, les avis d'affaires, l'engagement des clients et des partenaires, les événements (internes et externes) et les initiatives stratégiques en étroite collaboration avec Excellence des ventes, Finances et d'autres intervenants clés.
Collabore avec l'EMEA et des équipes mondiales à des programmes et initiatives fonciers, assurant ainsi l'harmonisation et l'excellence d'exécution interfonctionnelles.
Identifier et préconiser des mesures d'amélioration du rendement, travailler en étroite collaboration avec SE&O sur la planification des ressources, l'optimisation des plans et la gestion des effectifs.
Appuie l'établissement des objectifs transformationnels de l'organisation dans les domaines des RH, de l'expérience client, des finances et de la planification opérationnelle.
Promouvoir l'identité et la culture de l'ATU par l'orchestration de mairies, d'ateliers de leadership et d'équipes hors site, en favorisant l'alignement, l'engagement et un sens commun de l'objectif dans toute la Suisse ATU.
Bâtir des partenariats entre les équipes de gestion des activités d'excellence commerciale, de finances, de RH, de marketing, de réussite client, de communications et d'EMEA afin de stimuler l'exécution des priorités clés et des objectifs organisationnels
Incite l'amélioration continue en captant et en agissant sur la rétroaction de l'équipe au moyen de plateformes telles que les signaux des employés, l'écoute des employés et d'autres boucles de rétroaction, en veillant à ce que les renseignements soient traduits en mesures significatives qui améliorent l'efficacité et l'engagement de l'équipe.

• Chef exécutif et communications d'équipe
Exécute la stratégie et les programmes de communication interne de l'ATU. Examens, soutiens et aide à affiner le travail des membres de l'équipe avec du contenu pertinent (p. ex., decks clients/partenaires, decks d'événements, résumés des résultats, team SharePoint).

• Capacité d'engagement des clients et des cadres supérieurs
Partenaires avec les équipes de comptabilité et les cadres supérieurs afin d'encourager les engagements des clients à grande incidence par la préparation d'exposés stratégiques, l'alignement des messages, la préparation des cadres supérieurs et le suivi après l'engagement.
Appuyer l'élaboration de cadres d'engagement des clients qui favorisent l'uniformité, l'impact et les résultats mesurables.

• Maximiser / étendre l'équipe de leadership de l'ATU
Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès de l'équipe de direction de l'ATU en Suisse, en assurant l'alignement sur les priorités, la prise de décision, le suivi des cadres et l'efficacité organisationnelle.
Dirige la cadence de l'équipe de leadership, la gestion des programmes, le suivi des mesures et la responsabilisation interfonctionnelle.

• Projets, programmes et initiatives spéciaux
Diriger ou contribuer à des projets stratégiques intersectoriels qui répondent à des besoins opérationnels en évolution.
Exécute des travaux pratiques dans de multiples disciplines, y compris des efforts stratégiques qui nécessitent la coordination, l'analyse et la gestion des intervenants.
Dirige des initiatives qui améliorent l'efficacité organisationnelle, l'expérience des employés et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

• Transformation de l'IA
Indique les possibilités d'améliorer la productivité et l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à l'automatisation, aux solutions compatibles avec l'IA et à l'innovation des processus.

Compétences
Obligatoire/Qualification minimale

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion, informatique et expérience en gestion des affaires dans les environnements de vente et de terrain et de travail sur le rythme des affaires, y compris les opérations commerciales, la gestion des affaires, les finances ou d'autres environnements similaires

• OU expérience équivalente

• Expérience dans l'orchestration des stratégies d'engagement des commanditaires exécutifs, y compris la préparation d'exposés, l'alignement des intervenants et la responsabilisation de suivi pour accroître l'impact client.

• Suivre les résultats des principaux programmes interfonctionnels et des projets spéciaux qui stimulent la transformation des activités, la satisfaction de la clientèle et l'optimisation des processus internes.
Qualifications préférées :

• L'allemand (écrit et verbal) est fortement préféré, pour dialoguer efficacement avec les parties prenantes régionales et soutenir la communication à travers les marchés germanophones. Le français et l'italien constitueraient un atout supplémentaire.
